newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Low rates bode well for investment - Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Low rates bode well for investment - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday the lowering of official interest rates in 1996 boded well for further investment in 1997.
"We've already reduced official interest rates and that augurs well for continued investment in 1997," Costello told parliament.
Costello said earlier on Wednesday that strong investment levels were leading economic growth in Australia.
Official rates were last cut on November 6 when the Reserve Bank of Australia reduced the official cash rate to 6.5 percent from 7.0 percent.
Australia's seasonally adjusted average gross domestic product rose 0.8 percent in the September quarter for an annual rate of 3.8 percent.
